info.title: JANSETU API
info.description:
JANSETU API for the Android app and the web portal.

**Auth.** `POST /auth/login` returns an access token (15 min) and a refresh token.
Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. On `401 token_expired` call `/auth/refresh`;
each refresh returns a new refresh token and the old one stops working.

**Errors.** Every error is `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`. Codes so far:

| Status | Code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `wrong_current_password` | change-password: current password wrong |
| 401 | `invalid_credentials` | wrong workspace code, user ID or password |
| 401 | `not_authenticated`, `invalid_token` | no / bad access token |
| 401 | `token_expired` | call `/auth/refresh` |
| 401 | `invalid_refresh_token` | log in again |
| 401 | `session_ended` | logged out or ended by a password change; log in again |
| 403 | `account_locked` | too many wrong passwords; try later |
| 403 | `account_disabled`, `workspace_suspended` | access switched off |
| 403 | `device_required` | surveyors / booth agents must log in from the app |
| 403 | `device_pending` | phone waits for admin approval; poll `/devices/me` |
| 403 | `device_blocked` | phone blocked: wipe local data |
| 403 | `password_change_required` | call `/auth/change-password` first |
| 403 | `forbidden_role` | role too low |
| 404 | `not_found`, `no_device` | also returned for records outside your workspace or area |
| 422 | `validation_error` (with `details`), `weak_password` | |

IDs are UUIDs; dates are ISO 8601 UTC.

wipe_required.title: Wipe Required
wipe_required.description: True when an admin blocked this phone: delete all local data.

AdminDevice.title: AdminDevice
AdminDevice.description: A phone as an admin sees it.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Send to /auth/refresh. A new one is returned each time; the old one stops working.

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: If true, only /auth/change-password, /auth/logout and /devices/me work until the password is changed.

device.description: Null for a web portal session. If status is pending, poll /devices/me until an admin approves it.

wipe_required.title: Wipe Required
wipe_required.description: True when an admin blocked this phone: delete all local data.

device_uid.title: Device Uid
device_uid.description: Stable id of this install (Android ID, or a hash of it). The server stores only its SHA-256.

device.description: Required from the Android app. Omit from the web portal (portal login is allowed for supervisor and above).

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: Where this user works: every constituency for a super admin, their constituency for an admin, assigned wards / booths for others.

local_body_id.title: Local Body Id
local_body_id.description: Constituency of an admin / worker. Null for super admin.

terms_version.title: Terms Version
terms_version.description: Terms version the user accepted, or null.

WorkspaceSettings.title: WorkspaceSettings
WorkspaceSettings.description: Election details and feature switches. Candidate fields are null while code_of_conduct_mode is on.
